propositions: When models_at_or_above is called with a non-Anthropic-family model absent from MODEL_LADDER, it returns the entire ladder instead of just the primary, causing escalation to propose smaller-window Claude models
largest_window_tokens returns the ladder maximum (1000000) for an unlocated primary instead of the conservative ladder minimum (200000), overstating the context budget and causing silent truncation
Pass-1 escalation loop assigns the first returned model from an unlocated primary directly to run config without staying on the operator's configured provider family
Prerequisite-coverage escalation at prerequisites.py:260 has the same defect through models_at_or_above, jumping from nova-pro to claude-haiku-4-5 when the primary is unlocated

The fix returns [model] for truthy-but-unlocated primaries in models_at_or_above and uses ladder minimum for largest_window_tokens, preserving single-criterion retry while blocking cross-family escalation
Three out-of-scope test assertions in test_model_class_ladder.py encode the old defect behavior and must be updated after the fix lands
